Name: Slim Hutch Vanilla Flavor
Author: Oakenguard
Description:
Credit for this mod goes to PeaslyWellbott for the Slim Hutch, hassan94935 for the Grey Stone Slime Hutch, and cat9412 for the Grey Stone Slim Hutch recolor. Thanks so much for inspiring me to try and little bit of modding for once. It was a lot of fun!

This mod is a mashup of the Slim Hutch and original Slime Hutch. I wanted something with a little more visual flare for the Slim Hutch mod, so I repositioned the Slim Hutch's hatch and added the vanilla Slime Hutch's chimney, barred window, and a roof hatch, some of which I modified to fit the Slim Hutch's size. I also recolored parts of the Hutch to look more metallic using parts of hassan94935's Grey Stone Slime Hutch recolor.

Installation:
1. Install PeaslyWellbott's Slim Hutch
2. Download my mod and replace the "assets" folder in [CP] Slim Hutch with the file

This mod requires the Slim Hutch, so be sure to download that and check out hassan and cat's ReColors!

I might do some recolors for this in the future! I like the idea of red/brown brick, and I'd love to figure out how to add some seasonal vines and foliage to the exterior.

Downloads.Description: This is an assets folder with a png inside... that's it. Replace the assets folder in [CP] Slim Hutch with this... or just take the png out and override the one in the assets folder with it. You do you.
